background: hand-coloured etching on cream with a yellow wash

title: Animal locomotion, plate 756: Pigeon flying
creator: Eadweard Muybridge
institution: University of Pennsylvania Rare Book and Manuscript Library copy via Wikimedia Commons
attribution: Eadweard Muybridge, Animal locomotion, plate 756: Pigeon flying, 1884-1886 (published 1887). University of Pennsylvania Rare Book and Manuscript Library copy via Wikimedia Commons. Public domain.
background: grey-cream mount board with a dark printed frame; two rows of twelve phases each, 24 phases from one pigeon
notes: Collotype of a pigeon in flight in 24 consecutive phases on a gridded ground, one hand and one session. Each phase frame is about 540 x 1000 px at full size and the pigeon about 300 to 450 px wide, so it is a motion study to trace, not a high-resolution cutout. The plate mark is Copyright 1887 Muybridge, long expired.
